links.outcome: Prospective algorithm sensitivity and specificity versus echocardiography in local referred children
links.effect: When murmur audible, sensitivity 83% (24/29; CI 64-94%) and specificity 97% (59/61; CI 89-100%); algorithm missed defects without murmur (24/35 abnormal echo detected).
links.quote: When the murmur was audible, the sensitivity and specificity of the algorithm were 83% (24/29) (confidence interval (CI) 64-94%) and 97% (59/61) (CI 89-100%), respectively.

screen.reason: Prospective clinical validation of an AI algorithm analyzing heart sound signals for structural heart disease screening in children referred to a pediatric hospital.
